profile.summary: Community Alliance For Learning is an Oakland, California nonprofit that operated a program called WriterCoach Connection. The program trained volunteer coaches to work with middle and high school students in public schools on critical thinking and writing.

review.notes: Community Alliance For Learning (EIN 91-2144555, Oakland) is the legal entity behind WriterCoach Connection (LinkedIn slug, Network for Good page, matching Oakland address), and the program's 2023-24 Elmhurst United Middle School partnership matches the three OUSD agreements. The summary uses past tense, is neutral and supported (the organization announced it closed in May 2026); EIN, address, orgType and headquarters are supported by the cited pages.
